verdicts.quote: A freed spot goes to the first waiting member **automatically** (booked at once, member told). No offer/claim window
Order is first-come-first-served by the order the server commits joins … staff waitlist viewing or editing is out of scope
no per-member limit on simultaneous waitlists, no overlap rule beyond the existing booking rules … At promotion eligibility is checked again
verdicts.missing: The spec leaves open whether confirming one class immediately removes the member from the overlapping waitlist or leaves that entry for a later eligibility check.

verdicts.quote: existing late-cancel penalties make a surprise booking harmful … all existing eligibility and cancellation rules
verdicts.missing: Automatic booking eliminates the offer to decline. The spec leaves open whether missing the promotion notice and then cancelling late or failing to attend incurs the existing penalty.

verdicts.quote: when a booked member's cancellation frees a spot on a still-bookable class and members are waiting, the first eligible waiting member is booked into that spot **as part of the same operation**

In-app status is the mandatory notice; the existing notification channel, if any, is used additionally … "Confirmed (from waitlist)" … Cy remains booked and the status still shows it; the failure is logged
Ana and Ben cancel simultaneously (either order): booked [Cy, Dee], waiting [Eli]; each promoted exactly once … booked members never exceed capacity because of waitlist actions
Cy (waiting) books C1 directly: refused `on_waitlist` … a spot freed on a class that has waiting members cannot be taken by a direct booking, in any ordering

an ineligible head entry is skipped … the member is told, and the next entry is tried. Whatever the existing booking charges (credit, pass, payment) is applied at promotion, not at joining; a failed charge counts as ineligible.
No waitlist length cap
promotion can happen any time before the class's booking closes … the working assumption is the class start instant
raising a class's capacity promotes waiting members in order, one per new spot, until spots or the list run out. … Capacity lowered or unchanged: no promotion and no removal of anyone
when staff cancel a class, every waiting entry ends as `class_cancelled`, the members are told, and no booking is created for them.
Waitlist entry (new): class, member, join order, status … Positions are derived from a stored join order, not stored as mutable numbers.
verdicts.missing: A stored sequence can establish join order. The spec leaves open whether each entry also records the time the member joined.

verdicts.quote: When the booking-close instant passes, remaining entries end as `expired` … record kept as long as the existing booking records
Responses to a member (and the UI's data) contain own position and the count, but no other member's name or id
staff waitlist viewing or editing is out of scope … Join, leave, promote, skip-ineligible, expire, class-cancel and notice-failure each produce one log event with class id and member id
verdicts.missing: Staff viewing and manual changes are expressly excluded. The spec leaves open whether staff can access a timestamped history of promotions.

verdicts.quote: if the feature is switched off after entries exist, entries stay unpromoted until the feature returns or they expire; the platform's staged-release options and the promotion/stop condition are unknown
verdicts.missing: The rollback rule describes existing entries. It leaves open whether there is a supported on/off control and whether enablement can vary by class or class type.

verdicts.quote: a promotion is visible on the first read after the cancel returns.
A class with a free spot books exactly as before and shows no waitlist controls … existing bookings are untouched.
no migration or backfill; existing classes start with an empty waitlist … a signed-in member viewing a full, still bookable class they are neither booked in nor waiting for is offered "Join waitlist"
